recipes.name: Mini Key Lime Pies
ingredients_raw: 1 cup freshly squeezed Key lime juice

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Place crusts on a baking sheet.
Whisk sweetened condensed milk, sour cream, Key lime juice, and Key lime zest together in a bow until smooth; divide and pour into crusts, filling to the top.
Bake in the preheated oven until hot, 5 to 8 minutes. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, at least 1 hour. Garnish each pie with a Key lime slice and dollop of whipped cream.

raw_recipe.headline: Mini Key Lime Pies
raw_recipe.description: Nothing taste better than key lime pie made with fresh key limes. This one is really tasty and super simple to make. Mini pies are great because everyone can have their own.

review.reviewBody: Super fun and super easy. Everyone liked them, even the kids!

Way to much condensed milk.... almost 3 cans of condensed milk is way too much...threw away a lot of the batter.....14 oz can of condensed milk is actually measured by weight not volume it's actually 1 1/4 cup volume or 10 oz volume. Made it better the second time using 2 cups 16oz volume which is about 1 and 3/4 cans.

The key lime pies came out great! But the measurements on the website got all messed up. It went from saying 3 cups of sweetened condensed milk for 12 serving size to 3/4 of a cup when you DOUBLED the recipe... then when I went back to a regular serving (serves 12) it changed to 1/3 and 2 tps of sweetened condensed milk. When I would refresh the page it went back to 3 cups of it again... over all that was very confusing and I ended up doubling the recipe to make 24 mini pies and used 4, 14oz cans of sweetened condensed milk which tasted great! The only other thing was it didn’t make 24 mini pies.... the “doubling the recipe” to make 24 mini pies ended up really making 24 mini pies, and TWO ENTIRE pies. Long story short, the measurements are way off. It makes way too much... but it tastes great! 
Also I couldn’t find any pre made graham cracker shells so I made my own graham cracker crust and it came out great. 1 cup graham cracker crumbs, 6 TBSP butter, & 1/3 cup of sugar. I did use paper cupcake liners and it worked perfect... I saw in another comment to use foil ones if you make your own crust cause the butter soaked the paper but I didn’t experience that at all. 
I was actually happy that I made my own crust and used the paper cupcake liners because it came out amazing. 
Definitely will use this recipe again but will be careful with the measurements so I don’t make enough to feed an army and all the neighbors lol. 
Super delicious though! Definitely recommend making
Very tasty as written (and super easy to make!). Was well received and got lots of compliments. Made my own graham cracker crust and used a mini muffin tin to make perfect bite size “pies”.

I made the recipe as directed, other than substituting Key Limes for Rangpur Limes (a mandarin/lemon fruit). I used the Keebler mini-crusts from the grocery store and they turned out FANTASTIC! Even partygoers that do not typically eat dessert had one and ate every bite. My only wish is that I had a larger tree, since this took up almost all of my ripe fruit. Couldn't recommend this recipe more!
A+ I've made key lime pies for a few years. Wanted to try a new twist... This is it! Perfect combo, smooth, tangy and so tasty. I like the sour cream in place of eggs. My new key lime!

I cut the recipe in half and just made 6. I followed the recipe exactly, and they came out great! If you like your pie super limey, add more lime. I don't like an overpowering lime flavor in my key lime pie, or I feel like it starts to taste fake. This flavor was refreshing and perfect. They don't expand in the oven so go ahead and fill them all the way to the top like it says. I baked them for 6 minutes, cooled slightly, then chilled them. They were ready within an hour of being put into the fridge, but I left them overnight anyway. To fancy them up, I added some lime zest to the top along with a couple lemon balm leaves from my garden. Cute!

I have made these twice and they are wonderful and so easy! The grated zest is a nice touch. The first time, I made 6 for a small dinner party and halved the recipe. Tonight, I attended a dinner party for 15. Was able to fill 15 shells with the 12 pie recipe amounts. Topped with some raspberries and blueberries and served with mini cream puffs from another recipe on this site and chocolate covered strawberries. Made a very pretty plate with a nice assortment. Was devoured. Thanks for the recipe!

I’ve made this several times for our church bingo night. It’s one of the first things to go. I seem to always have more filling than tart shells, so I freeze the remaining and my husband just eats it like ice cream. I love love love this recipe. One quick thing, the recipe calls for 3 cups of sweetened condensed milk; You can just use two regular size cans and it works just fine.

I would put 3/4 cup sour cream vs 1 cup, but other then that, A++++

Very easy to make!

These were a hit. I could not find the graham cracker crusts that this called for so I had to make my own. Just a suggestion if you have to make your own crust use foil cup cake liners and not paper because the butter really seeped through and was a little messy.

Made these for my daughters gender revival party. Everyone loved them. There was not one left Just wondering if any of you have tried this recipe for making a large pie instead of the mini ones? Please let me know I would appreciate it. Thanks. 😊
Good but not traditional key lime pie so if you are looking for a traditional key lime pie recipe, this is not it.
We love this recipe! So easy to make! This is a perfect summer dessert that we will definitely make again!
Loved this recipe!! Followed it exactly, just baked for a few extra minutes until it was set. Had many people tell me this was the best key lime pie they’ve ever had!
Made these for a party big hit. I got 17 tarts out of one batch if I had the 18 all at once I would of squeezed it i. Very good
This was too easy for how good it was. It was perfect. I will definitely make it again.
No changes. They turned out perfectly.

made it last year for a friends wedding because it was his favorite dessert and he told me best he has ever had! For myself it was the first time having key lime pie and it was a great introduction with this recipe!

My Key lime tree is going crazy so l have been squeezing and freezing juice . I needed a quick dessert for a lunch party and found this wonderful recipe. Whipped it up in no time and still had enough time to chill them in time for lunch. Guests loved them!
